articles.summary: GlobeNewswire: C3is Inc. reports fourth quarter and twelve months 2025 financial and operating results. ATHENS, Greece, Feb. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- C3is Inc. (Nasdaq: CISS) (the “Company”), a ship-owning company providing drybulk and tanker seaborne transportation services, announced today its unaudited financial and operating results for the fourth quarter and twelve months ended December 31, 2025. articles.title: Russian Filippov wins first medal at Milan-Cortina Games for individual neutral athletes
articles.mainIdea: Russian Filippov wins first medal at Milan-Cortina Games for individual neutral athletes
articles.summary: AFP: Russian Filippov wins first medal at Milan-Cortina Games for individual neutral athletes. Russian Nikita Filippov won the first medal at the Milan-Cortina Games for individual neutral athletes when he claimed silver in the men's ski mountaineering sprint in Bormio on Thursday.Filippov and his AIN teammates have been allowed to compete at these Milan-Cortina Winter Olympics under a neutral banner having met strict conditions.
